changed_assumption.zh: 不再把 locality、footprint supervision 和 preservation objective 本身视为多轮安全更新的充分条件。新的假设是：即使每一轮局部编辑单独满足这些约束，连续更新仍会因同一依赖闭包中的覆盖、撤销和顺序效应产生路径依赖；因此真正需要学习的是一个在版本化 typed edit 上定义的规范组合律，而不是更强的局部编辑器。
changed_assumption.en: Locality, footprint supervision, and preservation objectives are no longer assumed sufficient for safe multi-round updating. Even when every local edit individually satisfies them, successive edits can create path dependence through overwrite, cancellation, and ordering interactions inside a shared dependency closure. The additional learned object is therefore a canonical composition law over versioned typed edits, not a stronger local editor.

exact_mechanism.zh: 保留原有 typed edit atom、C_keep、footprint label、locality mask 和 residual selector，但把连续 residual 先映射为显式 effect tuple，包括目标键、旧值域、新值域、依赖版本和契约标签，再由一个冻结的 normalizer 学习局部组合表：可交换 edits 被规范排序，覆盖 edits 合并为单一 versioned transition，相互撤销 edits 消去，冲突 edits 根据训练中独立执行得到的组合结果选择合法 normal form。训练额外加入三元 composition supervision：对同一起始 U，比较 R3∘R2∘R1 的真实执行结果与逐步正规化后的单一 residual normal form。最关键的简化基线获得完全相同的 typed edits、C_keep、footprint labels、locality mask、参数量和 preservation loss，并使用同一个 residual predictor，但删除 composition normalizer 与 composition-consistency loss，只把各轮局部 residual 顺序应用。
exact_mechanism.en: Retain the typed edit atoms, C_keep contracts, footprint labels, locality mask, and residual selector, but map successive residuals to explicit effect tuples containing target key, old-value domain, new-value domain, dependency version, and contract tags. A frozen normalizer learns a local composition table: commuting edits are canonically ordered, overwrites collapse into one versioned transition, mutually cancelling edits are eliminated, and conflicting edits are resolved according to independently executed composition outcomes observed during training. Training adds ternary composition supervision by comparing the actual execution of R3 composed with R2 composed with R1 from the same initial U against a single residual normal form produced by iterative normalization. The decisive simplification baseline receives exactly the same typed edits, C_keep, footprint labels, locality mask, parameter count, and preservation loss and uses the same residual predictor, but removes only the composition normalizer and composition-consistency loss and sequentially applies the local residuals.

children.update_surface: frozen versioned typed-edit residual normalizer plus localized persistent residual edits

learning_signal.zh: 训练样本由同一初始更新上真实执行的单轮、双轮和三轮 residual 链产生。监督包括最终任务结果、C_keep 结果、逐原子 footprint、以及两种组合路径是否得到同一可观察行为的 composition-equivalence 标签；不使用测试链反馈更新参数。
learning_signal.en: Training examples come from actually executing one-, two-, and three-step residual chains from the same initial update. Supervision includes final task outcomes, C_keep outcomes, per-atom footprints, and composition-equivalence labels indicating whether alternative composition paths produce the same observable behavior. No feedback from test chains updates the parameters.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 组合正确性由未参与 residual 或 normalizer 训练的独立执行 harness 判定：重新构建每个最终持久资产，在隐藏任务上执行 repair regression、C_keep 和冲突依赖测试，并直接比较规范组合与真实逐轮应用后的最终状态和行为。
independent_ground_truth.en: Composition correctness is determined by an execution harness unused for residual or normalizer training. It rebuilds each final persistent asset, executes hidden repair-regression, C_keep, and conflicting-dependency tests, and directly compares the final state and behavior of the canonical composition with actual sequential application.

simplest_baseline.zh: Residual-Locality-No-Algebra：与提出方法共享 typed edit representation、训练链、C_keep、footprint supervision、locality mask、residual predictor architecture、参数预算和全部单轮损失；唯一删除的因素是 residual composition algebra、normalizer 及 composition-consistency supervision。
simplest_baseline.en: Residual-Locality-No-Algebra shares the typed edit representation, training chains, C_keep, footprint supervision, locality mask, residual-predictor architecture, parameter budget, and every single-round loss. The only removed factor is the residual-composition algebra, its normalizer, and composition-consistency supervision.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按依赖图模式完整留出一组 4–6 轮更新链，其中包含训练中出现过的原子 edit 类型但未出现过的覆盖、撤销、交换和共享依赖组合。冻结两种方法后，在完全相同的起始 U 和 failure sequence 上运行。主指标为最终链 repair success 且全部 C_keep 满足的比例，辅指标为不同等价分组路径得到相同最终行为的 composition invariance。只有 proposed algebra 相对 Residual-Locality-No-Algebra 在 held-out multi-round chains 上显著提高联合成功率，并且优势集中在真实非平凡组合而非单轮 case，才支持主张。
decisive_pilot.en: Completely hold out dependency-graph patterns forming 4–6-round update chains that use familiar atomic edit types but unseen combinations of overwrite, cancellation, commutation, and shared dependencies. Freeze both methods and run them from identical initial U values under identical failure sequences. The primary metric is the fraction of chains achieving the repair while satisfying every C_keep contract; a secondary metric is composition invariance across behaviorally equivalent regroupings. The claim survives only if the proposed algebra materially improves joint success over Residual-Locality-No-Algebra on held-out multi-round chains and the gain is concentrated in genuinely nontrivial compositions rather than single-round cases.

stop_condition.zh: 若 locality+preservation 基线在 held-out 多轮链上的联合 repair/C_keep 成功率与 proposed algebra 等价，或去掉 composition constraint 后性能不下降，则停止“残差代数带来额外价值”的主张；若 normal form 与真实逐轮执行经常不一致，也直接停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop the residual-algebra claim if the locality-plus-preservation baseline matches the proposed method on joint repair/C_keep success over held-out multi-round chains, if removing composition constraints causes no degradation, or if the predicted normal form frequently disagrees with actual sequential execution.

material_change.zh: v5.2 不再把强 locality 和 preservation 作为与普通局部修复器混杂的一揽子贡献，而把唯一待验证差异压缩为版本化 residual 的组合正规形，并构造除该代数外完全相同的强基线。
material_change.en: v5.2 removes locality and preservation as confounded sources of advantage and reduces the unique proposed contribution to a versioned residual-composition normal form, tested against a strong baseline identical in every respect except that algebra.

title.zh: 预算分账契约路由与转译器

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把“选对 surface”和“在该 surface 上生成好资产”作为一个不可分解的成功事件。假设两种能力必须分别被证伪：router 只负责在固定资产之间选择，transpiler 只负责在已知正确 surface 内生成资产；组合收益只有在两个子问题各自成立后才有意义。
changed_assumption.en: Correct surface selection and good within-surface asset generation are no longer treated as one indivisible success event. The two capabilities must be independently falsified: the router chooses only among fixed assets, while the transpiler generates an asset only after being given the correct surface. Composed-system gains matter only after both components independently succeed.

exact_mechanism.zh: 预先为 prompt、memory 和 tool-constraint 三个 surface 各构建一个容量匹配资产 A_prompt、A_memory、A_tool，并在训练 target 上离线确定它们的 contract profiles。冻结 router r(z_model,C) 后，routing-only 测试中禁止 transpiler 参与，router 仅从三个固定资产标签中选一项。transpiler-only 测试直接提供独立 oracle surface，并要求 transpiler 从同一 contract C 生成与该 surface 的预构建资产容量相同的资产。最后才运行 composed router→transpiler。对每个新 target 明确定义部署 ledger M=6 次目标执行：前 2 次固定 diagnostic probes 产生 z_model，后 4 次只能用于被选 surface 的 contract check；所有 diagnostic、validation、fallback 和 candidate execution 都计入 M。任何额外 target execution 都视为超预算。一个三 surface 穷举器若要用同样的 4-probe contract check 比较三个候选至少需要 12 次 candidate executions，即使不计 diagnostic 也超过 M=6，因此同一 ledger 下不可执行。
exact_mechanism.en: Prebuild one capacity-matched asset for each of the prompt, memory, and tool-constraint surfaces: A_prompt, A_memory, and A_tool, and determine their contract profiles offline on training targets. After freezing router r(z_model,C), the routing-only test forbids use of the transpiler and lets the router choose only among the three fixed asset labels. In the transpiler-only test, an independently determined oracle surface is supplied directly and the transpiler must emit an asset from the same contract C with the same capacity as the prebuilt asset for that surface. Only then is the composed router-to-transpiler system evaluated. For each new target, define a deployment ledger of M=6 target executions: the first two are fixed diagnostic probes producing z_model and the remaining four may only be used for contract checking of the selected surface. Every diagnostic, validation, fallback, and candidate execution counts toward M, and any additional target execution is a budget violation. An exhaustive three-surface procedure using the same four-probe contract check would require at least 12 candidate executions even before diagnostics, so it cannot fit within M=6.

children.update_surface: one persistently selected prompt, memory, or tool-constraint asset emitted from a shared typed contract

learning_signal.zh: router 仅用训练 backbone 上三个固定预构建资产的独立离线排序标签学习；transpiler 仅用 oracle-surface 条件下的 contract-to-asset 配对和该 surface 内的执行结果学习。两者参数、监督和验证日志分离，组合阶段不再学习。
learning_signal.en: The router learns only from independent offline rankings of the three fixed prebuilt assets on training backbones. The transpiler learns only from contract-to-asset pairs and execution outcomes conditioned on oracle surfaces. Their parameters, supervision, and validation logs are separated, and no learning occurs during composed evaluation.

independent_ground_truth.zh: oracle surface 由不向 router 或 transpiler 暴露的独立 adjudication suite 对三个预构建资产做完整评测得到；transpiler 资产质量由另一组隐藏任务比较其与同 surface 预构建资产的 required-effect、forbidden-effect 和 persistence-scope 满足率。部署 M ledger 与 adjudication suite 严格分账，后者只用于研究者计算 ground truth，不能被方法调用。
independent_ground_truth.en: The oracle surface is determined by an independent adjudication suite, hidden from both router and transpiler, that fully evaluates all three prebuilt assets. Transpiler quality is measured on a second hidden task set by comparing its emitted asset with the prebuilt asset on required effects, forbidden effects, and persistence scope. The deployment M ledger is strictly separated from the adjudication suite, which exists only to compute research ground truth and cannot be queried by the method.

simplest_baseline.zh: routing 子实验使用相同 2 个 diagnostics 的容量匹配三分类器以及预注册默认 surface；transpiler 子实验的最强简单基线就是该 oracle surface 上的固定预构建容量匹配资产。组合实验再加入只使用预注册默认 surface+其预构建资产的系统。任何 baseline 与 proposed system 都受相同 M=6 部署 ledger 约束。
simplest_baseline.en: For routing, use a capacity-matched three-way classifier from the same two diagnostics plus a preregistered default-surface rule. For transpilation, the strongest simple baseline is the fixed capacity-matched prebuilt asset on the oracle surface. The composed test additionally includes a system that always uses the preregistered default surface with its prebuilt asset. Every baseline and the proposed system obey the same M=6 deployment ledger.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在完全留出的 backbone swap 上依次做三个锁定实验。A：只替换 routing decision，三个 surface 的资产固定不变，比较 router 的 oracle-surface accuracy 和最终 contract success。B：直接给 oracle surface，比较 transpiler asset 与同 surface 的 prebuilt asset，要求在相同容量下不劣且在跨 backbone contract transfer 上有预注册优势。C：冻结 A/B 后组合，M=6 内完成 2 diagnostics+4 selected-surface checks，比较 oracle-assisted upper bound、默认 surface 和任何可在 M 内实现的搜索策略。若 A 或 B 单独失败，不允许用 C 的结果补救。
decisive_pilot.en: Run three locked experiments on fully held-out backbone swaps. A: vary only the routing decision while keeping all three surface assets fixed, measuring oracle-surface accuracy and downstream contract success. B: provide the oracle surface directly and compare the transpiler asset with the prebuilt within-surface asset, requiring non-inferiority at matched capacity and a preregistered advantage on cross-backbone contract transfer. C: freeze A and B, compose them, and operate within M=6 using two diagnostics plus four checks of the selected surface, comparing against an oracle-assisted upper bound, the default surface, and every search strategy feasible under M. Failure of A or B cannot be rescued by C.

stop_condition.zh: 若固定资产条件下 router 不优于容量匹配分类器/默认规则，或 oracle-surface 条件下 transpiler 不优于或明显劣于预构建 within-surface asset，则停止相应主张并不报告组合系统为机制成功；若任何部署调用未计入 M，预算主张同样作废。
stop_condition.en: Stop the corresponding claim if the router fails to beat the matched classifier/default rule with fixed assets, if the oracle-surface transpiler fails to match or improve on the prebuilt within-surface asset, or if any deployment target call is omitted from M. A composed score cannot be used to rescue a failed component.

material_change.zh: v5.2 把原先混合的 router-transpiler pilot 拆成两个可独立否证的机制实验，并首次给出封闭的 M=6 全调用 ledger，使“少于三 surface 穷举”成为真实预算约束而非文字描述。
material_change.en: v5.2 decomposes the previously confounded router-transpiler pilot into two independently falsifiable mechanism tests and introduces a closed M=6 all-call ledger that makes the impossibility of three-surface exhaustive evaluation an actual budget constraint rather than a verbal claim.

title.zh: 冻结式可组合角色契约子句库

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把跨任务可复用性定义成“有一个冻结 FSM 库”这一弱差异，而假设真正可迁移的单位是具有稳定接口的 motif-level precondition、transition、handoff 和 termination 子句；未见任务应通过复用这些相同子句组合执行，而不是为目标任务重新综合一个等价 FSM。
changed_assumption.en: Cross-task reuse is no longer defined merely by possessing a frozen FSM library. The transferable units are motif-level precondition, transition, handoff, and termination clauses with stable interfaces. An unseen task should execute by composing those same frozen clauses rather than synthesizing an equivalent target-task FSM anew.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从训练任务中把重复约束因子化为带唯一版本 ID 的 typed contract clauses，例如 PRE(motif,state,tool)、TRANS(motif,s_i,action,s_j)、HANDOFF(motif,out_schema,next_role) 和 TERM(motif,predicate)。只有在至少两个训练任务族中以相同语义接口复现的 clause 才进入冻结库。新任务仅由现有 motif router 选择 motif，并通过确定性 schema matching 组合已冻结 clauses；禁止生成新状态、新 transition 或目标任务特定 clause。外部 executor 直接执行组合后的约束。容量匹配 executable-workflow baseline 使用完全相同的训练轨迹、motif router、tool schemas、权限、最大状态数、最大 transition 数和推理 token，但学习一个 task-conditioned FSM synthesizer/retriever，在每个测试任务输入上产生完整 FSM；它不能访问 frozen clause IDs，但也禁止 target-task gradient/update，使其成为真正的零更新强替代。
exact_mechanism.en: Factor recurring training constraints into typed contract clauses with unique version IDs, such as PRE(motif,state,tool), TRANS(motif,s_i,action,s_j), HANDOFF(motif,out_schema,next_role), and TERM(motif,predicate). A clause enters the frozen library only if it recurs with the same semantic interface in at least two training task families. At test time, the existing motif router selects motifs and deterministic schema matching composes only frozen clauses; no new state, transition, or target-task-specific clause may be generated. An external executor enforces the composed contract. The capacity-matched executable-workflow baseline uses exactly the same training traces, motif router, tool schemas, permissions, maximum state count, maximum transition count, and inference tokens, but trains a task-conditioned FSM synthesizer or retriever that emits a complete FSM from each test-task input. It cannot access frozen clause IDs and also receives no target-task gradient or optimization, making it a genuine zero-update strong alternative.

children.update_surface: frozen versioned motif-level executable contract clauses enforced by an external role executor

learning_signal.zh: 训练信号来自跨任务重复出现且由真实执行验证的非法调用、前置条件违例、合法 transition、handoff 成功和 termination 事件。clause induction 只使用训练任务族；task-conditioned FSM baseline 使用完全相同事件和轨迹。
learning_signal.en: Learning signals are recurring cross-task events verified by execution: illegal calls, precondition violations, valid transitions, successful handoffs, and termination events. Clause induction uses only training task families, while the task-conditioned FSM baseline receives exactly the same events and trajectories.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 隐藏任务的正确工具权限、状态前置条件、必需 handoff 字段和终止条件由环境规范与人工独立编写的 executable assertions 给出，而不是由 learned contract 或 FSM 自己判定。最终 correctness 由环境执行日志与这些 assertions 比对。
independent_ground_truth.en: For hidden tasks, correct tool permissions, state preconditions, mandatory handoff fields, and termination conditions come from environment specifications and independently authored executable assertions rather than from either learned contracts or FSMs. Final correctness is determined by matching execution logs against those assertions.

simplest_baseline.zh: Task-Conditioned Executable FSM：相同 traces、motif router、schemas、permissions、状态/transition 容量和 inference budget；对每个新任务从输入描述直接综合或检索完整 FSM，但不复用 proposed frozen cross-task clauses，也不允许目标任务优化。
simplest_baseline.en: Task-Conditioned Executable FSM uses the same traces, motif router, schemas, permissions, state/transition capacity, and inference budget. It directly synthesizes or retrieves a complete FSM from each new task description but does not reuse the proposed frozen cross-task clauses and receives no target-task optimization.

decisive_pilot.zh: 完整留出一个任务族，并进一步构造训练中从未共同出现过、但每个 constituent motif 都出现过的 motif composition。两种方法冻结后零更新执行。比较任务成功、非法工具调用率、handoff assertion 通过率和 premature/non-termination。随后做三组定向消融：分别把 reusable PRE、TRANS、HANDOFF clauses 替换成无信息 permissive clause，同时保持 router、executor 和容量不变。核心主张仅在 frozen library 显著优于 task-conditioned FSM，且至少关键安全/交接优势在移除对应 reusable clause family 后消失时成立。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out an entire task family and additionally create motif compositions never jointly observed during training although each constituent motif was seen. Freeze both methods and allow zero target-task updating. Compare task success, illegal-tool-call rate, handoff-assertion success, and premature or missing termination. Then run three targeted ablations replacing reusable PRE, TRANS, and HANDOFF clauses respectively with uninformative permissive clauses while holding the router, executor, and capacity fixed. The reusable-contract claim survives only if the frozen library materially beats the task-conditioned FSM and its key safety or handoff advantage disappears when the corresponding reusable clause family is removed.

stop_condition.zh: 若 task-conditioned FSM 在完全留出任务族和 novel motif composition 上匹配冻结库，或去除 reusable precondition/transition/handoff clauses 后 proposed system 的优势仍保持，则停止“跨任务契约复用”主张，并把结果降级为普通 executable workflow synthesis。
stop_condition.en: Stop the cross-task contract-reuse claim if the task-conditioned FSM matches the frozen library on the held-out family and novel motif compositions, or if the proposed advantage remains after removing reusable precondition, transition, or handoff clauses. In that case the result reduces to ordinary executable workflow synthesis.

material_change.zh: v5.2 把可复用对象从模糊的完整 contract/FSM 改成可追踪版本 ID 的跨任务 clause primitives，并用容量匹配的零更新 task-conditioned FSM 正面对照，同时要求 clause-family 消融能够因果删除优势。
material_change.en: v5.2 changes the reusable object from a loosely defined complete contract/FSM into traceable versioned cross-task clause primitives, directly challenges them with a capacity-matched zero-update task-conditioned FSM, and requires clause-family ablations to causally remove the advantage.

title.zh: 结构等变更新差分失败先验

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把贡献定义成“参数化 policy 比检索更好”，而把唯一假设限定为：跨更新可迁移信息存在于与具体键名、工具名和节点身份无关的 typed relational structure 中；如果这个假设成立，一个显式结构等变且冻结的 failure prior 应在从未出现过的 structural update types 上超过同信息 kNN 和通用 direct diff-conditioned 模型。
changed_assumption.en: The contribution is no longer that a parameterized policy is inherently better than retrieval. The sole hypothesis is that transferable cross-update information lies in typed relational structure invariant to concrete key, tool, and node identities. If true, an explicitly structure-equivariant frozen failure prior should outperform same-information kNN and generic direct diff-conditioned models on structural update types never seen during training.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把 structural diff 图规范化为 typed relation motifs：例如 permission-add→scope-parent、rule-delete→dependent-rule、retrieval-rewrite→consumer 和 termination-change→loop-edge。encoder 对同类型节点重命名强制等变，并通过共享 motif factors 计算 failure-family logits；最终 π(f|G) 是所有局部 motif contribution 与有限 pairwise motif interaction 的归一化和。训练时额外加入 graph-renaming consistency 和 motif-mask contrast：对同一 diff 随机重命名实体后分布必须不变，屏蔽已由独立失败证据定位的关键 motif 时对应 failure-family logit 必须下降。测试前冻结全部参数。比较对象包括：(1) 在同一 canonical graph representation 上做 kNN 并统计邻居 failure-family histogram；(2) 参数量匹配的 generic graph/set encoder，直接从完整 diff 条件化 challenge allocation/generation，但不施加 proposed motif factorization 或 renaming equivariance。三者共享所有历史更新、challenge/verifier calls、replay 容量和 token。
exact_mechanism.en: Canonicalize structural diff graphs into typed relation motifs such as permission-add to scope-parent, rule-delete to dependent-rule, retrieval-rewrite to consumer, and termination-change to loop-edge. The encoder is constrained to be equivariant to renaming nodes of the same type and computes failure-family logits from shared motif factors; π(f|G) is the normalized sum of local motif contributions and a bounded set of pairwise motif interactions. Training additionally uses graph-renaming consistency and motif-mask contrast: arbitrary entity renaming of the same diff must leave the distribution unchanged, while masking a motif independently localized as causal for a failure must reduce the corresponding failure-family logit. All parameters are frozen before testing. Comparators are (1) kNN over the same canonical graph representation with empirical neighbor failure-family histograms and (2) a parameter-matched generic graph/set encoder that directly conditions challenge allocation/generation on the complete diff but has neither the proposed motif factorization nor renaming-equivariance constraint. All three share every historical update, challenge/verifier call, replay slot, and token budget.

children.update_surface: frozen parameterized structural failure-family prior controlling future challenge-budget allocation

learning_signal.zh: 唯一正标签是独立 verifier 确认的历史真实 regression 及其 failure-family；附加监督来自等价 diff 的实体重命名和已确认 failure-supporting motif 的遮蔽对比。当前测试 diff 的 verifier 结果不用于更新 prior。
learning_signal.en: The only positive labels are historical regressions and failure families confirmed by an independent verifier. Additional supervision comes from entity renamings of equivalent diffs and masking contrasts over motifs supporting verified failures. Verifier outcomes from the current test diff never update the prior.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 每个 held-out update 的真实 failure families 由预生成、未向 allocator 暴露的完整 challenge suite 加独立 verifier 确定。该 suite 的覆盖远大于三种方法实际获得的相同 challenge budget，因此 ground truth 不由任一 allocator 自己发现的样本定义。
independent_ground_truth.en: True failure families for each held-out update are determined by a pregenerated exhaustive challenge suite plus an independent verifier hidden from all allocators. This suite is substantially larger than the identical challenge budget available to the three compared methods, so ground truth is not defined by whichever failures an allocator happened to discover.

simplest_baseline.zh: 两个 same-information controls 必须同时通过：(1) Canonical-Diff-kNN，在相同 structural graph 上检索 k 个历史 diff 并直接使用 empirical failure-family histogram 分配预算；(2) Direct-Diff Allocator，一个参数量匹配的通用 graph/set-conditioned allocator/generator，使用相同训练 updates、failure labels 和完整 diff，但没有 proposed structural-equivariant motif prior。另保留 full-state replay baseline。所有方法严格匹配 challenge calls、verifier calls、历史样本、replay capacity 和 tokens。
simplest_baseline.en: Two same-information controls are mandatory: (1) Canonical-Diff-kNN, which retrieves k historical diffs from the same structural graph space and allocates budget according to their empirical failure-family histogram; and (2) Direct-Diff Allocator, a parameter-matched generic graph/set-conditioned allocator/generator trained on the same updates, failure labels, and complete diffs but without the proposed structural-equivariant motif prior. The full-state replay baseline is retained. Challenge calls, verifier calls, historical examples, replay capacity, and tokens are strictly matched across methods.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按 structural update type 而非随机样本划分留出，例如训练只含单一 permission/rule/retrieval motifs 及部分二元组合，测试保留新的 relation topology 和未见 motif compositions，同时随机重命名所有实体标识。冻结 allocator 后，在相同 challenge budget 下测 hidden-suite failure-family recall、first-hit efficiency 和 discovered-regression precision。只有 proposed prior 同时超过 kNN 与 Direct-Diff Allocator，且其优势在取消 renaming-equivariance/motif factorization 后消失，才允许声称存在可迁移 cross-update structure。
decisive_pilot.en: Hold out structural update types rather than random examples: training contains individual permission/rule/retrieval motifs and only a subset of pairwise compositions, while test data contains new relation topologies and unseen motif compositions with all entity identifiers randomly renamed. After freezing the allocators, measure hidden-suite failure-family recall, first-hit efficiency, and precision of discovered regressions under identical challenge budgets. Transferable cross-update structure is claimed only if the proposed prior beats both kNN and Direct-Diff Allocator and the gain disappears when renaming equivariance or motif factorization is removed.

stop_condition.zh: 若 kNN 或 capacity-matched direct allocator 在 held-out structural types 上匹配 proposed prior，或 proposed 优势依赖实体名称而在重命名后消失，则停止“参数化跨更新结构先验”主张；只保留当前 diff 条件化测试生成的工程结论。
stop_condition.en: Stop the parameterized cross-update structural-prior claim if either kNN or the capacity-matched direct allocator matches the proposed method on held-out structural types, or if the advantage depends on entity names and disappears under renaming. Only an engineering claim about current-diff-conditioned test generation would remain.

material_change.zh: v5.2 不再依赖一个普通 encoder 与弱 replay 对照，而把可检验差异收窄为结构重命名等变的 motif-factorized prior，并正面对比相同 structural information 的 kNN 和容量匹配 direct model。
material_change.en: v5.2 no longer relies on a generic encoder against a weak replay control. It narrows the testable difference to a renaming-equivariant motif-factorized structural prior and directly compares it with kNN and a capacity-matched direct model receiving the same structural information.

title.zh: 约束完备型类型化记忆顺序逻辑

changed_assumption.zh: 不再通过限制 baseline 只能表达固定 pairwise preference 来证明高阶逻辑，而假设 symbolic clause registry 的真正优势应来自跨组合复用变量化约束和保证精确满足，而不是表达能力不对称。强 baseline 必须看到完整 set context 并能表达任意 set-conditioned ordering。
changed_assumption.en: Higher-order logic is no longer justified by restricting a baseline to fixed pairwise preferences. The symbolic registry must instead earn its advantage through reusable variable-bound constraints and exact satisfaction across new compositions, while strong baselines see the entire set context and can express arbitrary set-conditioned orderings.

exact_mechanism.zh: 保持 provenance/function 预定义 memory types 和随机 permutation interventions，但诱导对象改为带类型变量的最小 constraint program，例如 if Exception E and Policy P co-occur then E≺P、if Safety S present then forbid Observation between S and ToolSchema、以及条件 reversal/commutativity。采用 MDL-style clause selection，仅保留能解释多个独立 training compositions 的 clause。测试时冻结 registry，由 exact constraint solver 在完整 co-retrieved set 上生成满足所有 clauses 的顺序。加入两个容量匹配 baseline：Conditional Pairwise Factor 为每一对元素计算依赖完整 set summary 的方向 potential，再求全局 permutation；Generic Set-Energy Model 直接给完整 typed set 的 candidate permutation 打分。二者接收相同 predefined types、完整集合、所有 permutation outcomes、参数/训练 budget，并允许表达 context-dependent reversal 和任意高阶 set effect。
exact_mechanism.en: Retain provenance/function-defined memory types and randomized permutation interventions, but induce a minimal constraint program with typed variables, for example: if Exception E and Policy P co-occur then E precedes P; if Safety S is present then forbid an Observation between S and ToolSchema; plus conditional reversal and commutativity clauses. MDL-style clause selection retains only clauses explaining multiple independent training compositions. At test time the frozen registry uses an exact constraint solver over the complete co-retrieved set. Two capacity-matched baselines are mandatory: Conditional Pairwise Factor computes pairwise directional potentials conditioned on a summary of the entire set and then optimizes a global permutation, while Generic Set-Energy Model directly scores candidate permutations of the complete typed set. Both receive the same predefined types, complete sets, every permutation outcome, parameter/training budget, and are allowed to represent context-dependent reversals and arbitrary higher-order set effects.

children.update_surface: frozen typed memory-order clause registry plus exact persistent ordering solver

learning_signal.zh: 对每个训练 co-retrieved set 随机或系统枚举足够多的排列，记录独立任务结果；三种模型使用完全相同的 set、type 和 permutation-outcome 数据。symbolic 方法额外只使用 clause sparsity/MDL regularization，不获得额外标签。
learning_signal.en: For each training co-retrieved set, sufficiently many permutations are randomized or systematically enumerated and independently evaluated. All three models use exactly the same sets, types, and permutation-outcome data. The symbolic method receives no extra labels beyond clause-sparsity/MDL regularization.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 测试 ground truth 来自对隐藏 type composition 中所有可行排列的独立执行，得到真正成功排列集合以及是否存在硬约束违例；这些枚举结果仅用于评价，不向 frozen clause registry 或 neural baselines 提供测试期反馈。
independent_ground_truth.en: Test ground truth comes from independently executing every feasible permutation for hidden type compositions, yielding the true successful-permutation set and hard-constraint violations. These enumeration results are used only for evaluation and provide no test-time feedback to the frozen registry or neural baselines.

simplest_baseline.zh: 至少两个强控制：(1) Conditional Pairwise Factor，pairwise potential 显式条件于完整 set，因此能够产生 context-dependent reversal；(2) Generic Set-Energy Model，对完整 permutation 做通用能量建模，因此不存在“baseline 被禁止表达三元关系”的问题。二者与 clause registry 参数规模、训练 permutation 数和 inference candidate budget 匹配。
simplest_baseline.en: At least two strong controls are required: (1) Conditional Pairwise Factor, whose pairwise potentials explicitly condition on the complete set and can therefore express context-dependent reversals, and (2) Generic Set-Energy Model, which assigns unrestricted energy to full permutations and is not prohibited from representing ternary relations. Parameter scale, number of training permutations, and inference candidate budget are matched to the clause registry.

decisive_pilot.zh: 训练仅覆盖部分 type compositions，完整留出需要已知 clauses 系统重组的新组合，例如 Exception+Policy 规则与 Safety ternary rule 首次同时出现，或同一 pair 在第三种 type 出现时必须 reversal。冻结三种方法后，在每个 unseen composition 上计算 exact-success rate、constraint-violation rate、与 exhaustive oracle 的 regret，并另测增加 memory identities 时的组合外推。高阶 symbolic 主张仅在 clause registry 相对两个强 set-conditioned baseline 对 held-out compositions 有明显更高 exact constraint satisfaction/成功率，而 training-composition fit 不只是更高时成立。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on only a subset of type compositions and completely hold out new compositions requiring systematic recombination of known constraints, such as the first co-occurrence of an Exception-Policy precedence rule with a Safety ternary rule, or a pair whose order must reverse when a third type appears. Freeze all methods and measure exact-success rate, constraint-violation rate, regret to the exhaustive oracle, and extrapolation as additional memory identities are introduced. The higher-order symbolic claim survives only if the clause registry materially improves exact constraint satisfaction or success on held-out compositions over both strong set-conditioned baselines, rather than merely fitting training compositions better.

stop_condition.zh: 若 conditional pairwise factor 或 generic set-energy model 在 held-out type composition 和 exact constraint satisfaction 上匹配 clause registry，则停止“高阶 symbolic logic 带来系统性泛化优势”的主张；若优势只出现在 baseline 表达受限的设置，也视为失败。
stop_condition.en: Stop the higher-order symbolic systematic-generalization claim if either the conditional pairwise factor model or generic set-energy model matches the clause registry on held-out type compositions and exact constraint satisfaction, or if the advantage appears only when a baseline is artificially expression-limited.

material_change.zh: v5.2 用能够观察完整集合并表达高阶效应的 neural ordering controls 替换了固定 pairwise strawman，把贡献压缩为变量化 clause 的系统组合泛化与 exact satisfaction guarantee。
material_change.en: v5.2 replaces the fixed-pairwise strawman with neural ordering controls that observe the complete set and can express higher-order effects, reducing the proposed contribution to systematic compositional generalization of variable-bound clauses and exact constraint satisfaction.

title.zh: 可认证张成空间外交互逆算子

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把行为 interaction residual 直接等同于参数空间中的“span 外方向”。新的假设是可操作的：只有当预注册参数更新空间内的所有 stored-delta 线性组合都无法同时满足 regression-repair 与 preservation 约束时，才允许调用一个学习出的新方向；interaction supervision 的价值必须相对一个看到完全相同历史干预但不做 residual target/projection 的通用 conditional generator 单独成立。
changed_assumption.en: A behavioral interaction residual is no longer equated with an out-of-span parameter direction. The operational hypothesis is that a learned new direction is justified only when every admissible linear combination of stored parameter deltas is certified unable to satisfy the preregistered regression-repair and preservation constraints simultaneously. The value of interaction supervision must also survive comparison with a generic conditional generator trained on the identical interventions but without residual targets or span projection.

exact_mechanism.zh: 在决定性 pilot 中把 persistent parameter update 限定为作用在冻结 representation 上的低秩线性 decision adapter，使每个 stored atom delta Δ_i 和候选 repair Δ=Σ_i α_iΔ_i 都处于明确参数空间。预注册 repair probes 要求目标动作 margin 至少提高 γ_r，preservation probes 要求每个保持行为的 logit/margin 变化不超过 γ_p；由于 representation 冻结，这些约束对 α 是线性不等式。对每个 failure composition 先求一个线性可行性问题；若 infeasible，保存 LP dual/Farkas certificate，证明在预注册 coefficient box 内不存在任何 stored-delta-span patch 能同时满足约束。只有这些 certified cases 用于训练 proposed generator。它接收 update-atom summaries、failure probes、preservation constraints 和由 single/pair/full rollback 得到的 explicit interaction residual target，并将输出方向投影到 stored-delta span 的正交补后再学习系数。强简化 baseline 使用完全相同输入、相同训练 interventions、同样低秩 adapter rank、参数量和 optimizer，但不给 explicit interaction-residual target，也不做 span projection，直接生成 conditional patch。
exact_mechanism.en: For the decisive pilot, restrict persistent parameter updates to a low-rank linear decision adapter operating on frozen representations, placing every stored atom delta Δ_i and candidate repair Δ=sum_i α_iΔ_i in a well-defined parameter space. Preregistered repair probes require the target-action margin to improve by at least γ_r, while preservation probes bound changes in each protected logit or margin by γ_p. Because representations are frozen, these become linear inequalities in α. For every failing composition, first solve a linear feasibility problem; if infeasible, retain its LP dual/Farkas certificate proving that no patch inside the stored-delta span and preregistered coefficient box can satisfy repair and preservation simultaneously. Only such certified cases train the proposed generator. It receives update-atom summaries, failure probes, preservation constraints, and explicit interaction-residual targets derived from single, pairwise, and full rollback interventions, and its generated direction is projected into the orthogonal complement of the stored-delta span before coefficients are learned. The strong simplification baseline receives identical inputs, identical training interventions, the same adapter rank, parameter count, and optimizer, but receives no explicit interaction-residual target and performs no span projection; it directly generates a conditional patch.

children.update_surface: persistent low-rank decision-adapter inverse library containing certified new repair directions

learning_signal.zh: 训练数据包含相同 update composition 的 single-atom、pairwise 和 full rollback executions。proposed 方法使用由这些执行差分构造的 interaction target；baseline 只能使用相同 executions 的最终 regression/preservation losses。两者只在经过独立 span-infeasibility certificate 的训练 cases 上比较。
learning_signal.en: Training data contains single-atom, pairwise, and full rollback executions for the same update compositions. The proposed method uses interaction targets constructed from these execution differences, while the baseline may use the same executions only through final regression and preservation losses. The comparison is restricted to training cases with independently certified span infeasibility.

independent_ground_truth.zh: “span 内无解”由确定性的 LP solver 和可检查 dual certificate 给出，而最终 repair 是否真实有效由与 LP probe 分离的隐藏环境任务执行判定，包括目标 regression、未受影响任务和未见 paraphrase/context。参数 certificate 与行为 ground truth 因而是两套独立证据。
independent_ground_truth.en: The statement that no in-span solution exists is established by a deterministic LP solver with a checkable dual certificate. Whether the resulting repair actually works is judged separately by hidden environment executions not used in the LP probes, including target regressions, protected tasks, and unseen paraphrases or contexts. Parameter-space certification and behavioral ground truth are therefore independent evidence sources.

simplest_baseline.zh: No-Residual Conditional Generator：接收完全相同的 atom summaries、failure probes、preservation constraints、single/pair/full rollback interventions，使用相同 adapter rank、参数量、训练步数和 optimizer；但不接收 explicit interaction-residual targets，也不把输出投影出 stored-delta span。另保留最强 span-only oracle，在 LP 可行时直接求最优 α；核心 out-of-span case 只在 LP 已认证 infeasible 时计入。
simplest_baseline.en: No-Residual Conditional Generator receives exactly the same atom summaries, failure probes, preservation constraints, and single/pair/full rollback interventions with the same adapter rank, parameter count, training steps, and optimizer, but receives no explicit interaction-residual targets and does not project outputs away from the stored-delta span. A strongest span-only oracle is also retained and directly solves for optimal α whenever the LP is feasible; core out-of-span cases are counted only when span infeasibility has been certified.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造训练中仅见单原子与部分二元组合、测试完整留出新的三元/四元 update compositions 的小型 frozen-representation agent。先对每个测试 failure 在不查看生成器输出的情况下运行 span-feasibility LP，并只把带有效 dual certificate 的 infeasible cases 放入主分析。冻结两个 generator 后，在相同 certified cases 上比较 hidden execution repair success、preservation success 及二者联合成功率；同时记录输出方向与 stored span 的主夹角。核心机制只有在 proposed interaction-target+projection generator 显著超过 No-Residual Conditional Generator，并且 hidden behavior 改善只出现在确实 certified out-of-span 的 cases 上时成立。
decisive_pilot.en: Use a small frozen-representation agent in which training includes atomic and only some pairwise updates, while novel three- and four-way update compositions are completely held out. Before inspecting either generator output, run the span-feasibility LP for every test failure and include in the primary analysis only infeasible cases with valid dual certificates. Freeze both generators and compare hidden-execution repair success, preservation success, and their joint success on exactly those certified cases, while also recording the principal angle between each generated direction and the stored span. The mechanism survives only if the interaction-target-plus-projection generator materially outperforms the No-Residual Conditional Generator and the hidden behavioral gain occurs specifically on cases genuinely certified as out of span.

stop_condition.zh: 若所谓 out-of-span cases 无法获得有效 infeasibility certificate，若 span-only oracle 实际能满足预注册 repair+preservation constraints，或容量匹配 No-Residual Conditional Generator 与 proposed 方法表现等价，则停止“interaction-conditioned nonlinear inverse 合成必要新方向”的主张。
stop_condition.en: Stop the claim that an interaction-conditioned nonlinear inverse must synthesize a new direction if purported out-of-span cases lack valid infeasibility certificates, if the span-only oracle can in fact satisfy the preregistered repair-plus-preservation constraints, or if the capacity-matched No-Residual Conditional Generator matches the proposed method.

material_change.zh: v5.2 将原先语义含混的 behavioral residual“span 外”陈述改成可验证的参数级 LP infeasibility 命题，并增加一个除 interaction target 与 projection 外信息、容量、干预完全相同的 conditional generator，从而把真正机制差异单独暴露出来。
material_change.en: v5.2 replaces the ambiguous claim that a behavioral residual is out of span with a verifiable parameter-level LP infeasibility statement and adds a conditional generator identical in information, capacity, and interventions except for interaction targets and span projection, isolating the actual proposed mechanism.

title.zh: 类型条件交互签名商迁移器

changed_assumption.zh: 商类不再由训练期出现过的 memory identity 及其已观测超边决定，而由一个可迁移的、identity-free 类型条件交互算子决定。两个从未见过的记忆只有在冻结算子根据其类型、结构角色、检索位置和上下文类型预测其 pair/triple 干预残差等价时，才允许进入同一压缩类。
changed_assumption.en: Quotient classes are no longer determined by training-seen memory identities and their observed hyperedges. They are determined by a transferable identity-free, type-conditioned interaction operator. Two unseen memories may share a compression class only when the frozen operator predicts equivalent pair/triple intervention residuals from their types, structural roles, retrieval positions, and contextual types.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从训练记忆中完全移除 identity token，定义 phi(m)=[memory type, provenance type, retrieval role, dependency degree, trigger schema, action/read-write signature]。对相同预算下的单项、pair 和 triple add/delete/substitute 干预计算真实交互残差 r_S=Delta(S)-sum_i Delta({i})。训练冻结预测器 F_theta(phi(m_i), phi(context), composition pattern) 输出残差分布及置信区间。对新 identity，先用 F_theta 预测其与候选上下文的交互签名，再仅当边际效应等价且所有高置信预测残差差异低于阈值时合并为 quotient class。压缩完成后冻结 memory store 和 F_theta；未来任务不再进行身份级重拟合或干预搜索。
exact_mechanism.en: Remove memory-identity tokens entirely and define phi(m) from memory type, provenance type, retrieval role, dependency degree, trigger schema, and action/read-write signature. Under a fixed budget, obtain ground-truth interaction residuals from singleton, pair, and triple add/delete/substitute interventions, r_S = Delta(S) - sum_i Delta({i}). Train a frozen predictor F_theta(phi(m_i), phi(context), composition pattern) that outputs residual distributions and uncertainty. For unseen identities, predict their interaction signatures with candidate contexts and form quotient classes only when marginal effects are equivalent and every high-confidence predicted residual difference is below threshold. After compression, freeze both the memory store and F_theta; no identity-specific refitting or intervention search is allowed on future tasks.

children.update_surface: persistent memory quotient classes plus typed interaction-signature hyperedges

learning_signal.zh: 监督仅来自训练身份上的受控 singleton/pair/triple 替换干预残差；identity 标签不进入预测器输入。损失同时拟合残差均值、置信区间覆盖率和“可合并/不可合并”边界。
learning_signal.en: Supervision comes only from controlled singleton/pair/triple substitution residuals on training identities; identity labels are excluded from predictor inputs. The loss fits residual magnitude, uncertainty calibration, and the merge-versus-veto boundary.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 在完全未用于训练或阈值选择的新 memory identities 与新类型组合上重新执行真实 pair/triple 干预，以冻结压缩前后的任务成功、受保护行为和交互残差作为独立真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: On memory identities and type compositions entirely excluded from training and threshold selection, rerun actual pair/triple interventions and use task success, protected behaviors, and measured interaction residuals before versus after frozen compression as independent truth.

simplest_baseline.zh: interaction-aware veto table/classifier：使用完全相同的 singleton/pair/triple 干预、相同特征可见范围、相同存储位数和相同目标压缩率，直接学习“某候选合并是否应 veto”，但不形成类型化交互签名或 quotient algebra。
simplest_baseline.en: An interaction-aware veto table/classifier using exactly the same singleton/pair/triple interventions, feature visibility, storage bits, and target compression rate, directly predicting whether each proposed merge should be vetoed, without typed interaction signatures or quotient algebra.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按 memory identity 和组合同时 disjoint 划分；只在训练身份上拟合。测试包含从未出现的单身份以及训练中从未出现的 type composition。在 3 个固定压缩率下比较冻结 quotient、容量匹配 veto 和仅边际效应压缩器的行为保持率。若 quotient 的优势只发生在 seen identity，而在 unseen identity/composition 上不超过 veto，则失败。
decisive_pilot.en: Use splits disjoint in both memory identity and composition, fitting only on training identities. Test both wholly unseen individual identities and type compositions absent from training. At three fixed compression rates, compare the frozen quotient against the capacity-matched veto and a marginal-only compressor on behavioral preservation. The claim fails if gains occur only for seen identities or disappear relative to the veto on unseen identities/compositions.

stop_condition.zh: 若在任一预注册的中高压缩率上，unseen-identity/composition 的行为保持前沿未显著超过同预算 veto，或允许 identity 特征后才出现优势，或冻结压缩导致受保护行为退化超过预设容忍值，则停止该方向。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the behavioral-preservation frontier on unseen identities/compositions does not exceed the matched veto at any preregistered medium/high compression point, if the advantage requires identity features, or if frozen compression degrades protected behavior beyond the preregistered tolerance.

material_change.zh: 修复点不是再增加超边，而是把决定商类的对象从训练身份上的已记忆交互表改成可冻结迁移的 identity-free 类型条件交互预测算子，并以完全相同干预数据和存储预算的 veto 方法作为主简化检验。
material_change.en: The repair does not add more hyperedges. It changes the quotient-defining object from a memorized interaction table over training identities to a frozen, identity-free type-conditioned interaction predictor, with a same-intervention, same-storage veto method as the primary simplification test.

title.zh: 非加性局部消息效应场

changed_assumption.zh: 零搜索通信图构造的可迁移信息不再被定义为各边独立效用之和；核心可检验对象改为：在相同 task motif 下，一条边的效应会因邻接边是否存在而系统改变，而这种局部非加性残差能够跨任务族迁移。
changed_assumption.en: Transferable information for zero-search graph construction is no longer defined as the sum of independent edge utilities. The testable object becomes a systematic change in an edge's effect caused by the presence of neighboring edges under the same task motif, with this local nonadditive residual transferring across task families.

exact_mechanism.zh: 使用相同 normal/mask/length-matched replacement/joint-mask 数据，先拟合共享 additive 主效应 a_theta(x_e)。随后只从联合干预可识别部分学习局部残差 q_theta(x_e,x_f,c_local)，并强制 q 在没有 joint-mask 证据支持的远距离边对上为零。候选图 G 的冻结预测效用为 U(G)=sum_{e in G} a_theta(x_e)+sum_{(e,f) in N(G)} q_theta(x_e,x_f,c_local)-lambda*token(G)。评测任务上只计算一次该冻结效用并在固定 edge/token 预算下选择图，不使用 target reward。主对照将相同参数预算全部用于 additive regressor，且看到完全相同的 joint-mask executions，但预测形式被限制为 sum_e a'*theta(x_e)。
exact_mechanism.en: Using the same normal, mask, length-matched replacement, and joint-mask executions, first fit a shared additive main effect a_theta(x_e). Learn a local residual q_theta(x_e,x_f,c_local) only from components identifiable by joint interventions, forcing q to zero for distant edge pairs unsupported by joint-mask evidence. The frozen utility of a candidate graph G is U(G)=sum*{e in G} a_theta(x_e)+sum_{(e,f) in N(G)} q_theta(x_e,x_f,c_local)-lambda*token(G). On evaluation tasks, compute this frozen utility once and construct a graph under fixed edge/token budgets without target reward. The primary control allocates the same parameter budget to an additive regressor that sees the identical joint-mask executions but is restricted to sum_e a'*theta(x_e).

children.update_surface: persistent task-family communication graph selected from a frozen edge-interaction effect model

learning_signal.zh: 训练信号为同一执行集合产生的成功率、token 成本和错误传播变化；q 的监督是联合 mask 实测效应减去两个单边主效应所得的非加性残差，不引入额外 rollout。
learning_signal.en: The learning signal is the change in success, token cost, and error propagation from the same execution set. Supervision for q is the measured joint-mask effect minus the two singleton main effects; no additional rollout is introduced.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 完整留出的任务族在图构造完成后才运行真实 agent executions；其任务正确性由独立任务答案/环境状态判定，错误传播由预定义错误注入传播标签判定，均不进入图选择。
independent_ground_truth.en: Entirely held-out task families are executed only after graph construction. Task correctness is judged by independent answers/environment states and error propagation by preregistered injected-error propagation labels; none are available during graph selection.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配 additive task-conditioned edge-effect regressor：获得完全相同的 task motifs、角色、局部描述、normal/mask/replacement/joint-mask executions、token 预算和参数量，但不允许显式 pairwise residual 或邻接交互项。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched additive task-conditioned edge-effect regressor receiving exactly the same task motifs, roles, local descriptors, normal/mask/replacement/joint-mask executions, token budget, and parameter count, but with no explicit pairwise residual or adjacency interaction term.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选取至少三个 held-out task families，并预先定义一组存在正、负和近零真实联合残差的局部 edge motifs。冻结后分别由非加性模型和 additive baseline 在同 edge/token 预算下零搜索构图。主指标是 held-out-family success-minus-cost frontier；机制指标是 q 对真实联合残差的符号和排序预测。只有两者都优于 additive 才支持主张。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least three held-out task families and preregister local edge motifs spanning positive, negative, and near-zero measured joint residuals. After freezing, let the nonadditive model and additive baseline construct graphs with zero search under identical edge/token budgets. The primary metric is the held-out-family success-versus-cost frontier; the mechanism metric is sign/rank prediction of measured joint residuals. Both must improve over the additive model.

stop_condition.zh: 若容量匹配 additive predictor 在 held-out-family 图质量上达到统计等价，或 q 不能预测真实 joint residual，或优势需要目标任务 reward/topology search 才出现，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the capacity-matched additive predictor is statistically equivalent on held-out-family graph quality, if q fails to predict actual joint residuals, or if any advantage requires target-task reward or topology search.

material_change.zh: 将主张缩窄为相同干预数据下“可迁移的非加性局部效应”是否提供 additive 回归无法恢复的信息；所有额外数据优势被移除，pairwise 结构必须直接赢过同数据同容量的加法模型。
material_change.en: The claim is narrowed to whether transferable local nonadditive effects contain information unrecoverable by an additive model under identical intervention data. All extra-data advantages are removed, and the pairwise structure must directly beat a same-data, same-capacity additive predictor.

title.zh: 全留出有向对效应潜变量转译

changed_assumption.zh: 共享潜变量的价值不再由“能够从 effect signature 生成目标资产”本身证明，因为直接 decoder 也可能完成该任务；唯一保留的假设是：跨表面对齐得到的 z_effect 在完整未见有向 surface pair 上提供了超出原始 probe signature 和固定 canonical IR 的可迁移结构。
changed_assumption.en: A shared latent is no longer justified merely because an asset can be generated from an effect signature, since a direct decoder may do the same. The surviving assumption is specifically that cross-surface alignment makes z_effect carry transferable structure that improves a completely unseen directed surface pair beyond both the raw probe signature and a fixed canonical IR.

exact_mechanism.zh: 采用 directed-pair leave-one-out crossed experiment：对表面集合 S 中每个测试方向 A→B，训练数据删除所有 A→B 配对监督，同时保留其他方向。源侧 A 的 probe suite 对所有方法完全相同并计入总调用/token 成本。方法将同一 source asset 与 probe signature 编码为 z_effect，并由 B 的 typed decoder 生成更新；训练仍使用跨表面对比和 cycle consistency。冻结后禁止在 A→B 上微调。主 direct baseline 跳过 z_effect：以同一 source-side probe signature、source schema、B schema 和容量约束直接预测 B update，参数量、调用数与解码 token 匹配。第二 baseline 将 probe signature 映射到预定义 canonical behavioral-effect IR，再由固定 B compiler 实现更新。
exact_mechanism.en: Use a directed-pair leave-one-out crossed experiment. For every tested direction A→B over a set of surfaces S, remove all A→B paired supervision while retaining other directions. The source-side probe suite on A is identical for all methods and its calls/tokens count toward total cost. The proposed method encodes the same source asset and probe signature into z_effect and uses B's typed decoder to produce the update, trained with cross-surface contrastive and cycle objectives. After freezing, no A→B adaptation is allowed. The primary direct baseline bypasses z_effect and maps the same source-side probe signature, source schema, B schema, and capacity constraint directly to a B update with matched parameters, calls, and decoding tokens. A second baseline maps the signature into a fixed canonical behavioral-effect IR followed by a fixed B compiler.

children.update_surface: persistent target-surface asset generated by a frozen cross-surface effect encoder/decoder

learning_signal.zh: 训练使用非测试方向上的行为等价 repair groups、其 source-side probe signatures、目标资产监督，以及 effect-equivalence contrastive/cycle objectives；测试 A→B 的任何配对实例和 hidden contracts 均不参与训练或选择。
learning_signal.en: Training uses behavior-equivalent repair groups from non-test directions, their source-side probe signatures, target assets, and effect-equivalence contrastive/cycle objectives. No paired instance or hidden contract from the tested A→B direction participates in fitting or selection.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 对生成的 B 资产执行完整留出的 hidden contracts，包括目标行为、受保护行为、触发边界以及可执行性；这些 contract 在模型训练、早停和 hyperparameter selection 中完全不可见。
independent_ground_truth.en: Execute generated B assets against fully held-out hidden contracts covering target behavior, protected behavior, trigger boundaries, and executability. These contracts are absent from training, early stopping, and hyperparameter selection.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配 direct effect-signature translator：获得完全相同的源资产、probe signature、source/target schemas、目标容量、API calls、probe 执行次数与 token，总体网络参数量匹配，但没有共享 latent、contrastive 或 cycle objective；另设固定 canonical IR 作为结构化非学习捷径。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched direct effect-signature translator receiving the identical source asset, probe signature, source/target schemas, target capacity, API calls, probe executions, and tokens, with matched overall network capacity but no shared latent, contrastive objective, or cycle objective; a fixed canonical IR serves as the structured non-learned alternative.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少选择四种异质 surface，形成多个完整留出的 A→B 方向，并逐方向重新训练而不是仅留出实例。在每个方向记录 hidden-contract fidelity、protected-behavior violation、可执行率及包含 probe 的总成本。预注册要求 z_effect 在多数 held-out directions 上同时超过 direct signature baseline 和 canonical IR，而非仅平均值获胜。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least four heterogeneous surfaces to create multiple wholly held-out A→B directions, retraining for each held-out direction rather than merely holding out instances. Measure hidden-contract fidelity, protected-behavior violations, executability, and total cost including source probes. Preregister that z_effect must beat both the direct-signature baseline and canonical IR on a majority of held-out directions, not merely in an aggregate average.

stop_condition.zh: 若 direct effect-signature baseline 在成本匹配后与 z_effect 等价或更优，若 canonical IR 已达到同等 fidelity，或优势只存在于训练见过的 surface direction，则停止共享潜变量主张。
stop_condition.en: Stop the shared-latent claim if the cost-matched direct effect-signature baseline is equivalent or superior, if the canonical IR already reaches the same fidelity, or if gains occur only on surface directions observed during training.

material_change.zh: 该 child 的关键变化是把完整有向 surface pair 留出和同成本 direct-signature/canonical-IR 对照写入方法定义本身，使 z_effect 只有在相同 probe 信息下产生额外跨方向迁移能力时才有科学含义。
material_change.en: The material repair makes complete directed-surface-pair holdout and cost-matched direct-signature/canonical-IR controls part of the method definition, so z_effect is scientifically meaningful only if it adds cross-direction transfer beyond the same probe information.

title.zh: 留出版本生成算子的边际收益迁移

changed_assumption.zh: 核心问题不再是随机干预是否比观察式 curriculum 更“因果”，而是由一类模型版本生成过程上的随机微分配所学习的 next-unit gain 函数，能否冻结迁移到一种完整未参与拟合的版本生成算子。
changed_assumption.en: The central question is no longer whether randomized interventions are more 'causal' than observational curricula. It is whether a next-unit gain function learned from randomized micro-allocations under one set of model-version-generating processes can be frozen and transported to an entirely held-out version-generating operator.

exact_mechanism.zh: 预先定义多个 version-generating operators O，例如不同但固定的优化器/数据混合更新规则，每个 O 产生自己的 checkpoint stream v_1,...,v_T。训练只使用 O_train 中的随机微分配 tuple (phi(v_t),k,p_t,Delta_t)，其中 epsilon 探索概率和 micro-block 大小固定。学习 g_theta(phi(v),k) 预测下一单位收益及不确定性。评测时冻结 theta，切换到从未用于训练的 O_test；控制器不能利用 O_test 上已实现 micro-allocation 的 outcome 更新 theta，只根据当前版本表示给主要预算排序。Actor-Curator baseline 获得相同 epsilon 探索预算；direct contextual baseline 获得完全相同训练 tuples、phi(v)、k 和历史监督，直接回归/选择 next task，不使用 propensity correction 或显式 gain estimator。所有方法在 O_test 的冻结比较期间不在线更新。
exact_mechanism.en: Preregister multiple version-generating operators O, such as distinct fixed optimizer/data-mixture update rules, each producing a checkpoint stream v_1,...,v_T. Training uses only randomized micro-allocation tuples (phi(v_t),k,p_t,Delta_t) from O_train with fixed epsilon exploration probabilities and micro-block size. Learn g_theta(phi(v),k) to predict next-unit gain and uncertainty. At evaluation, freeze theta and switch to an O_test never used for fitting; outcomes of realized O_test micro-allocations may not update theta, and main-budget ranking uses only the current version representation. An Actor-Curator baseline gets the same epsilon exploration budget. A direct contextual baseline gets exactly the same training tuples, phi(v), k, and historical supervision and directly regresses/selects the next task without propensity correction or an explicit gain estimator. No method updates online during the frozen O_test comparison.

children.update_surface: persistent curriculum allocation policy induced by a frozen version-conditioned next-unit gain predictor

learning_signal.zh: 每个训练 operator 上随机 micro-block 前后的独立 validation delta、回归锚点变化、记录 propensity 和版本表示；所有比较器读取相同 tuple 集，不能从额外在线回报获得监督。
learning_signal.en: The signal consists of independent pre/post-micro-block validation deltas, regression-anchor changes, logged propensities, and version representations from each training operator. All compared methods consume the same tuple set and receive no extra online reward supervision.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 在 O_test 上，对预先抽样的一小部分 evaluation checkpoints 复制模型并对每个候选 task family 分别执行一个真实 micro-block，得到独立 next-unit validation gain oracle；这些 crossed interventions 仅用于事后评估，不反馈控制器。
independent_ground_truth.en: At preregistered evaluation checkpoints under O_test, clone the model and execute one real micro-block separately for each candidate task family to obtain an independent crossed-intervention oracle of next-unit validation gain. These interventions are evaluation-only and never fed back to the controller.

simplest_baseline.zh: 两个主基线：(1) Actor-Curator 式 policy-improvement bandit，具有完全相同的 epsilon 探索率、训练预算和回归锚点；(2) same-data direct contextual bandit/response model，使用完全相同随机微分配 tuples 和版本表示，以匹配容量直接预测收益或任务选择，不使用显式因果估计结构。
simplest_baseline.en: Two primary baselines: (1) an Actor-Curator-style policy-improvement bandit with identical epsilon exploration, training budget, and regression anchors; and (2) a same-data direct contextual bandit/response model with matched capacity, trained on the exact randomized micro-allocation tuples and version representations to predict gain or task choice directly without an explicit causal-estimation structure.

decisive_pilot.zh: 使用至少三个 version-generating operators，执行 leave-one-operator-out。对每个 held-out operator，在多个 rolling checkpoints 上测量预测 gain 与 crossed oracle 的 rank correlation、top-1 regret，以及固定总预算后的最终 validation improvement。方法必须在冻结状态下同时超过 Actor-Curator 和 direct contextual baseline，并且优势不能只来自一个 operator。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least three version-generating operators in leave-one-operator-out experiments. At multiple rolling checkpoints of each held-out operator, measure correlation with the crossed gain oracle, top-1 allocation regret, and final validation improvement under a fixed total budget. The frozen method must outperform both Actor-Curator and the direct contextual baseline, with gains not confined to a single operator.

stop_condition.zh: 若 direct contextual response model 使用同一 tuple 后达到统计等价，若 Actor-Curator 在同探索预算下不劣，或 g 仅能在训练见过的 version-generating operator 内有效而无法冻结迁移，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the direct contextual response model is statistically equivalent on the same tuples, if Actor-Curator is non-inferior under the same exploration budget, or if g works only within version-generating operators seen during training and fails frozen transport.

material_change.zh: 该修复把主要科学对象从一般性的“随机干预 curriculum”改成“跨完整留出版本生成算子的冻结 marginal-gain transport”，并用相同探索预算 bandit 与相同 tuple 的 direct response model 作为真正等价对照。
material_change.en: The repair changes the scientific object from a generic randomized-intervention curriculum to frozen marginal-gain transport across an entirely held-out version-generating operator, tested against both a same-exploration bandit and a same-tuple direct response model.

title.zh: 编译器残差式契约编辑器

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把 schema 可直接推出的字段/工具重绑定算作 learned typed-IR 的贡献。确定性 schema-diff/compiler 首先完成所有可由已知 source/target schema 唯一决定的迁移；学习器只负责剩余的关系残差，即无法由 schema diff 单独确定、但对 precondition、retrieval topology 和 temporal contract 保持必要的编辑。
changed_assumption.en: Field/tool rebinding deterministically implied by source/target schemas is no longer credited to the learned typed IR. A deterministic schema-diff/compiler first performs every uniquely schema-determined migration. The learner is responsible only for the residual relational edits that schema diff alone cannot determine but that are necessary to preserve preconditions, retrieval topology, and temporal contracts.

exact_mechanism.zh: 给定 source/target schemas，先运行共享 deterministic compiler C_schema，生成基础迁移资产 M0，包括字段重命名、工具签名替换和可直接求解的 constraint substitutions。随后 typed residual editor E_theta 只能从白名单编辑中预测 delta_R：依赖边重定向、语义谓词绑定和时序约束关系调整；最终资产为 Apply(M0,delta_R)。所有候选均通过同一 type/reference/constraint checker V。容量匹配 monolithic rewriter 也获得 source asset、两侧 schema、M0、完全相同的 V，以及完全相同次数的 checker-guided repair/rejection attempts。若 E_theta 不输出编辑，则结果严格退化为 deterministic compiler。
exact_mechanism.en: Given source/target schemas, first run a shared deterministic compiler C_schema to produce a base migrated asset M0 containing field renaming, tool-signature substitution, and directly solvable constraint substitutions. A typed residual editor E_theta may then predict only whitelisted residual edits delta_R: dependency-edge redirection, semantic-predicate binding, and temporal-constraint relation changes. The final asset is Apply(M0,delta_R). Every candidate is checked by the same type/reference/constraint verifier V. A capacity-matched monolithic rewriter receives the source asset, both schemas, M0, the identical verifier V, and the identical number of checker-guided repair/rejection attempts. If E_theta emits no edits, the method exactly reduces to the deterministic compiler.

children.update_surface: persistent memory contract after deterministic schema compilation plus learned residual relational edits

learning_signal.zh: 监督不再包含可由 schema compiler 自动恢复的编辑；这些步骤从 target edit sequence 中剥离。学习器只拟合 compiler 后仍导致 hidden contract 失败、且由 source/target traces 可确认的最小关系残差编辑。
learning_signal.en: Supervision excludes edits recoverable automatically by the schema compiler; those steps are stripped from target edit sequences. The learner fits only minimal residual relational edits that remain necessary after compilation and are supported by source/target traces.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 使用未参与训练的 joint model+harness/schema swaps；真值由目标环境中的真实执行、隐藏 precondition checks、retrieval-dependency checks 和 temporal execution contracts 决定，而 checker 通过本身不等同于成功。
independent_ground_truth.en: Use unseen joint model+harness/schema swaps. Ground truth comes from actual target-environment execution plus hidden precondition, retrieval-dependency, and temporal-execution contracts; merely passing the static checker does not count as success.

simplest_baseline.zh: 两条主基线均共享 verifier：(1) deterministic schema-diff/compiler，只执行从 schemas 可推出的字段/工具重绑定和约束求解；(2) capacity-matched monolithic rewriter，拥有相同 M0、type/reference/constraint checker 和相同 checker-guided repair/rejection 次数。
simplest_baseline.en: Both primary baselines share verifier access: (1) a deterministic schema-diff/compiler performing field/tool rebinding and constraint solving implied by known schemas; and (2) a capacity-matched monolithic rewriter with the same M0, type/reference/constraint checker, and identical checker-guided repair/rejection count.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造 crossed joint swaps：每个 case 同时改变 model behavior interface 与 harness/schema，并标注哪些目标修复可由 deterministic compiler 解决、哪些需要 schema 未决定的 relational residual。对 compiler-only、checker-equalized monolithic 和 residual IR editor 使用相同源数据、解码预算和 verifier attempts。主要比较后一类 residual-required cases 的 hidden-contract success，同时报告 compiler-solvable 子集以确认三者不因基础重绑定能力不同而产生假优势。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct crossed joint swaps in which both the model behavior interface and harness/schema change, and annotate which target repairs are compiler-solvable versus require schema-underdetermined relational residuals. Give compiler-only, checker-equalized monolithic, and residual IR editing identical source data, decoding budget, and verifier attempts. The primary comparison is hidden-contract success on residual-required cases, while compiler-solvable cases verify that no gain comes from unequal basic rebinding ability.

stop_condition.zh: 若 deterministic compiler 已解决绝大多数 joint swaps，若 checker-equalized monolithic 在 residual-required subset 上与 typed residual editor 等价，或收益主要来自更多 verifier repair attempts，则停止 typed-IR 主张。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the deterministic compiler already solves nearly all joint swaps, if the checker-equalized monolithic rewriter is equivalent on the residual-required subset, or if gains are attributable mainly to extra verifier-guided repair attempts.

material_change.zh: 修复把 schema-diff 可确定部分从学习问题中显式扣除，并统一所有方法的 verifier access；typed IR 现在必须证明的是对“编译器之后仍存在的关系残差”进行受限编辑的价值，而非重新获得静态检查或 API 重绑定优势。
material_change.en: The repair explicitly subtracts all schema-diff-determined work from the learning problem and equalizes verifier access. Typed IR must now demonstrate value specifically on relational residuals remaining after deterministic compilation, rather than benefiting from static checking or API rebinding.

title.zh: 滤波式纵向评价器状态外推

changed_assumption.zh: 时间顺序不再只是训练数据的附加特征，而被要求通过显式 state-space prior 进入新 evaluator 的状态推断；只有上一版本状态经 transition 形成的先验能在当前无标签 fingerprint 含糊时改变最终 residual correction，才算存在纵向状态外推。
changed_assumption.en: Chronology is no longer merely an auxiliary feature in the training data. It must enter new-evaluator inference through an explicit state-space prior. Longitudinal extrapolation exists only if the prior generated by transitioning the previous evaluator state changes the final residual correction when the current unlabeled fingerprint is ambiguous.

exact_mechanism.zh: 令 o_t=EncFingerprint(f_t)。上一 evaluator 的后验状态为 z*{t-1}。首先计算时间先验 z_t^- = T_theta(z_{t-1},Delta t_t)；随后由当前无标签 fingerprint 产生 observation update：z_t = z_t^- + K_phi(z_t^-,o_t)*(o_t-H_psi(z_t^-))。对 actor a 的 evaluator bias residual 为 r_hat(a,t)=C_omega(d_a,z_t)，最终校正分数为 s_corr(a,t)=s_raw(a,t)-r_hat(a,t)。T_theta 因而通过 z_t^- 明确进入最终分数。所有参数仅在历史版本上训练后冻结；未来 evaluator 不允许任何人工或任务标签。对照 history-aware direct predictor D 获得完全相同的有序历史 fingerprints、当前 fingerprint、timestamps、actor descriptors 和历史 actor×evaluator supervision，但直接输出 r_hat=D(history,o_t,Delta t,d_a)，不存在 latent transition/filter。
exact_mechanism.en: Let o_t = EncFingerprint(f_t), with z_{t-1} the posterior state of the previous evaluator. First compute a chronological prior z_t^- = T_theta(z_{t-1}, Delta t_t). Then update it with the current unlabeled fingerprint: z_t = z_t^- + K_phi(z_t^-,o_t)*(o_t-H_psi(z_t^-)). For actor a, predict evaluator bias residual r_hat(a,t)=C_omega(d_a,z_t), and correct the score as s_corr(a,t)=s_raw(a,t)-r_hat(a,t). Thus T_theta explicitly affects the final score through z_t^-. All parameters are trained only on historical versions and then frozen; no human or task labels from future evaluators are allowed. The history-aware direct baseline D receives the exact same ordered fingerprint history, current fingerprint, timestamps, actor descriptors, and historical actor-by-evaluator supervision but directly predicts r_hat=D(history,o_t,Delta t,d_a) with no latent transition/filter.

children.update_surface: persistent evaluator-bias correction head conditioned on a frozen chronologically filtered evaluator state

learning_signal.zh: 历史 evaluator 的无标签 fingerprints、时间戳和 crossed actor×evaluator 独立真值残差联合训练 observation encoder、transition/filter 与 correction head；未来 evaluator 的 fingerprint 只参与冻结 observation update，不产生任何监督梯度。
learning_signal.en: Historical unlabeled evaluator fingerprints, timestamps, and independently labeled crossed actor-by-evaluator residuals jointly train the observation encoder, transition/filter, and correction head. A future evaluator's fingerprint participates only in the frozen observation update and generates no supervised gradient.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 每个 rolling-origin held-out evaluator version 的人工/任务真值评分仅在全部预测冻结后揭示，用于计算 actor-level residual error、ranking agreement 和 calibration；这些 future-version labels 不可用于状态推断、阈值选择或再训练。
independent_ground_truth.en: Human/task ground-truth scores for each rolling-origin held-out evaluator version are revealed only after all frozen predictions are produced and are used to measure actor-level residual error, ranking agreement, and calibration. These future-version labels cannot be used for state inference, threshold selection, or retraining.

simplest_baseline.zh: 两个严格主基线：(1) current-fingerprint static model，只使用当前 fingerprint 与 actor descriptor；(2) capacity/budget-matched history-aware direct predictor，拥有与 state model 完全相同的有序 fingerprint history、当前 fingerprint、timestamps、actor descriptors、历史监督和推理 token，但无 latent transition，直接预测 future residual。
simplest_baseline.en: Two strict primary baselines: (1) a current-fingerprint static model using only the current fingerprint and actor descriptor; and (2) a capacity/budget-matched history-aware direct predictor with the exact same ordered fingerprint history, current fingerprint, timestamps, actor descriptors, historical supervision, and inference tokens as the state model, but no latent transition and direct prediction of the future residual.

decisive_pilot.zh: 采用至少 5 个连续 evaluator versions 做 rolling-origin：每一轮只训练到 t-1，零 anchor 预测 t。比较 state filter、static 与 direct-history 模型的 residual MAE、actor ranking error 和 calibration。再执行 chronology permutation：在保持 fingerprints、timestamps 边际分布、模型容量和监督数量不变的情况下随机打乱历史版本顺序并重新训练。预注册通过条件为 state filter 在多数 origins 上显著超过两个 baseline，且打乱顺序后该增益消失。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least five sequential evaluator versions in rolling-origin evaluation: for each origin, train only through t-1 and predict t with zero anchors. Compare the state filter, static model, and direct-history model on residual MAE, actor-ranking error, and calibration. Then perform chronology permutation: randomly shuffle historical version order while preserving fingerprint/timestamp marginals, model capacity, and supervision count, and retrain. Preregister that the state filter must significantly beat both baselines on a majority of origins and that the gain must disappear after chronology permutation.

stop_condition.zh: 若 history-aware direct predictor 达到统计等价，若 transition prior 对最终 s_corr 的消融几乎无影响，若 rolling-origin 优势仅来自单一 future version，或 chronology permutation 后优势仍保持，则停止“纵向状态外推”主张。
stop_condition.en: Stop the longitudinal-state claim if the history-aware direct predictor is statistically equivalent, if ablating the transition prior barely changes final corrected scores, if gains are confined to one future version, or if the advantage survives chronology permutation.

material_change.zh: 该 child 将时间算子从模糊的序列建模叙述改为最终校正路径中的显式 state-space prior/observation filter，并用接收完全相同历史信息的 direct predictor 作为等价非状态对照；同时以 rolling-origin 和 chronology permutation 验证时间顺序是否真正提供不可替代信息。
material_change.en: The child replaces a vague sequential-modeling story with an explicit state-space prior/observation filter in the final correction path and compares it against an equivalent non-state direct predictor receiving the same history. Rolling-origin evaluation and chronology permutation test whether temporal order contributes genuinely irreplaceable information.
